Method of Attack: Encrypts all files in the Zimbra email message store folder using AES encryption with a unique AES key per victim, which is then encrypted with an RSA key and emailed to attacker addresses
Creates ransom note demanding 3 bitcoins to decrypt files
Likely installed by developer hacking into Zimbra server and executing Python script
Discoverer: visitor who reported to the source
Attack Vector: Hacking into Zimbra server and executing Python ransomware script
